tasks.title: Assemblies-per-room → paint/drywall/flooring quantities + wall heights
tasks.prep: engine/assemblies.py is scaffolded from B1. Full implementation pass: (1) define assembly rules per room classification — bedroom/living/office: flooring SF (= room area) + wall paint SF (= perimeter × height) + ceiling SF (= area) + baseboard LF (= perimeter) + door count; bathroom: same + tile SF. (2) Add wall height input to the measure route — default 9.0 ft, per-room override stored in Measurement.wall_height_ft (add column if not present). (3) Wire the math: wall_paint_sf = perimeter × height (perimeter is already in meta.perimeter), ceiling_sf = area, flooring_sf = area. (4) Output one assembly row per room per quantity in the 5-tab Excel workbook with CSI trade codes. This is the last pillar separating the engine from estimator-grade Excel output.
